description: This file defines a class `Env` that provides static accessors for environment configuration variables sourced from a `.env` file, utilizing the flutter_dotenv package.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: A utility class providing static getters to access environment variables such as API URLs, keys, and configuration parameters.

methods.name: apiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the API base URL from environment variables or a default value.

methods.name: apiKey
methods.description: Returns the API key from environment variables or an empty string.

methods.name: websocketUrl
methods.description: Returns the WebSocket URL from environment variables or an empty string.

methods.name: supabaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the Supabase URL from environment variables or an empty string.

methods.name: supabaseAnonKey
methods.description: Returns the Supabase anonymous key from environment variables or an empty string.

methods.name: fcmSenderId
methods.description: Returns the FCM sender ID from environment variables or an empty string.
